name: Forno Acqua MultiSINK Stainless Steel 33" Dual Mount Double Bowl Sink with Faucet and Waterfall
shortDescription: Elevate your kitchen with the MultiSINK DuoFLOW featuring our signature WaterWall. This dual-bowl sink combines sleek symmetry with smart functionality—offering a full-basin roll-up grid that transforms your sink into a flat prep surface, while the deck-mounted faucet delivers three spray modes and precise control of the integrated WaterWall. Dual-mount installation and IAPMO certification ensure lasting quality and universal fit. Built for seamless rinsing, prepping, and cleaning, DuoFlow is where performance meets modern design.
